keys.description: Where pseudonymisation keys live. Unset, or `none`, means no pseudonyms, no key material and no resolve.

dir.description: Where the wrapped data keys are kept. They are random, not derived, so this directory is the only copy; unset keeps them in memory, which a trial install may do and nothing else should.

rootFile.description: A file holding the 32-byte root the data keys are wrapped under.

prefix.description: What every key's name starts with: <prefix>.<purpose>.<tenant>.

openbao.description: How a process reaches an OpenBAO transit engine: where it is, and exactly one way of signing in.

caFile.description: A PEM bundle trusted beside the system roots, for a server on a private chain.

login.description: Sign in with a JWT: the pod's projected service-account token, presented to an auth mount. Nothing is stored.

jwtFile.description: The file holding the JWT, read at every login because the kubelet replaces a projected token before it expires.

mount.description: The JWT auth mount, for example jwt-devel.
Where the transit engine is mounted.

namespace.description: The OpenBAO namespace the engine and the auth mount are in. Unset is the root namespace.

tokenEnv.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding a token.

tokenFile.description: A file holding a token, read on every call, for a token something else keeps renewed.

postgres.description: A PostgreSQL connection. The URL carries no password: a password in it is refused, and `passwordEnv` names the environment variable that holds it.

sink.description: The writer this process records through.

tokenFile.description: A file holding the token presented to the writer, read afresh on every request: in a cluster, the pod's projected service-account token. Unset presents none, which an anonymous trial install accepts.

description: The configuration of audit-query, the read path. Secrets are never in this file: a field named ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

archive.description: The archive the records are in: where a record's standing in the digest chain is read for Get, and what the s3scan searcher reads. Without it Get still answers, with where the copy is and nothing about whether it has been verified.

prefix.description: The prefix within the bucket. Required in a bucket shared with other installations: it is what keeps two of them apart.

database.description: The index, as a role that does NOT own the tables: tenant row-level security binds only a non-owner.

deployment.description: Path to the profile configuration, which a grant preset turns roles into profiles with.

exports.description: Where exports go: a bucket of its own with no Object Lock, which clears them. Without it the export operation is refused.

expiry.description: How long an export is kept before the bucket clears it.

linkValid.description: How long a download link works.

grants.description: Path to the file naming the trusted issuers and mapping their claims to grants.

keys.description: The writer's key provider, which turns resolve on: a query service without the keys cannot undo a pseudonym whatever a grant says. It needs `archive`.

searcher.description: Where answers come from: `postgres` (the index), or `s3scan` (the archive, within a budget) for a deployment with no database.

title: audit-query
